summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of the cipher-box project, implementing vault blob v2 binary format across core, API, desktop (Rust), and web client, with a security review and simplification pass.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully: v2 blob format in @cipherbox/core, API migration endpoint, Rust desktop support, and web client login flow. Security issues fixed, code simplified, and a critical bug in folder sync (fetchAndDecryptMetadata not handling v2 binary blobs) was discovered and fixed during UAT. Recovery tool substantially improved but subfolder traversal limited by DHT propagation.

repo: The vault migration IIFE runs silently on login — NestJS doesn't auto-log incoming requests, so absence of logs ≠ absence of calls. Confirmed success via direct DB query.

orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields even when OpenAPI spec is correct — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a bug.
fetchAndDecryptMetadata in both folder.service.ts and sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without v2 detection — any migration to v2 format broke folder sync.

IPFS gateway at 192.168.133.114:8080 supports CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) and resolves `/ipns/{name}` in a single request returning `X-Ipfs-Roots` header with the CID. Kubo API port 5001 does NOT send CORS headers.
Subfolder IPNS records are only stored in the CipherBox API DB cache and not propagated to the public DHT, making subfolder traversal in the recovery tool impossible without API auth.
The IPNS controller requires JWT auth for all endpoints — recovery tool cannot use it as a fallback for IPNS resolution.
Docker stack exposes Kubo gateway on port 8080 (CORS-enabled) and API on port 5001 (no CORS). Port 5001 works server-side but not from browser.

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without v2 detection — crashes with SyntaxError on v2 binary blobs. Fixed by adding detectBlobVersion/deserializeVaultBlobV2 handling before JSON.parse.
Same v2 blob handling bug as folder.service.ts — required identical fix.
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs. Fixed by hoisting above try/catch and reusing result. Also had redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair.
Desktop vault init ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey twice with same public key — once for DB, once for v2 blob. Fixed to reuse first wrap result.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 lacked key length bounds check — silent u16 truncation possible. Changed to return Result with explicit validation.
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, printing encrypted key material. Fixed with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields.

fetchFromIpfs could return undefined on non-404 gateway failures, causing detectBlobVersion to crash on undefined.length. resolveIpns was parsing CBOR-wrapped delegated routing responses as raw protobuf. Fixed by using /ipns/{name} gateway path with HEAD request to extract CID from X-Ipfs-Roots header.

workflow: When API calls are absent from logs, query the DB directly before assuming failure — NestJS doesn't auto-log requests.
The gsd-debugger agent added diagnostic console.logs to trace silent failures, which revealed the migration had already succeeded on first login.
Security review + simplify pass caught real issues (double ECIES wrap, duplicate HKDF derivation, missing bounds checks) that weren't caught during initial implementation.
Playwright is invaluable for checkpoint UAT — can evaluate JS in browser context to extract runtime state (private keys, store values) without adding debug UI.
GSD debug workflow: spawn debugger agent → add diagnostics → use Playwright to capture browser console → analyze → clean up diagnostic code and commit.

friction: The vault migration appeared to fail silently because NestJS doesn't log requests by default — required DB query to confirm success, wasted significant investigation time.
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields forces `as unknown as string` casts throughout the codebase — no clean fix available without switching codegen tools.
Kubo API port 5001 lacks CORS headers, making it unusable from browser-based recovery tool despite being accessible server-side.
IPNS records for subfolders are not propagated to public DHT, making the recovery tool unable to traverse folder trees — fundamental architectural limitation.
The delegated routing API returns CBOR-wrapped responses, not raw protobuf — the recovery tool's initial IPNS resolution was parsing garbage and silently using it.
API connection refused error interrupted the first security review attempt, requiring a retry.
HMR session clearing after code changes required re-login with fresh OTP during Playwright testing sessions.
open_items: Recovery tool subfolder traversal fails when IPNS records aren't on public DHT — requires either DHT propagation on publish or an authenticated API endpoint for recovery.
M-1 (security): Recovery tool private key not zeroed from memory after use.
M-2 (security): No dedup guard on concurrent vault migration from multiple browser tabs — race condition possible.
M-3 (security/efficiency): Unnecessary ECIES re-wrap on every FUSE root folder publish — should cache wrapped key in AppState.
L-1 (security): Zero-length key accepted by v2 blob deserializers.
L-2 (security): No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html.
Device registry sync fails with CryptoError: Invalid registry format in validateDeviceEntry — pre-existing schema mismatch (todo captured).
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failures during login — pre-existing issue (todo captured).
E2E tests for vault v2 recovery tool need to be written (todo captured).
Subfolder IPNS records should be published to the public DHT on write to enable recovery tool traversal.
